name: atoms/example-plain-php
description: Illustrative composer.json for the plain-PHP Atoms recipe. Not wired into the monorepo's root install — the root composer.json's autoload-dev maps Atoms\Examples\PlainPhp\ straight to src/ so the adapter conformance suite can exercise this code without a separate install.
_readme: This file exists to show a customer what to require, not for this repo to install. See examples/plain-php/README.md.
